title: ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2608.30423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be mad

translated_title: ObjectSplat：通过对象级网格溅射提升3D场景的网格保真度与交互性
translated_abstract: 基于溅射（splatting）的算法能够从普通图像中重建出照片级真实感、可实时渲染且可导出网格的3D场景，但它们将场景表示为单一的整块场。因此，重建结果缺乏对象级结构，导致下游编辑或交互无法实现。此外，输入扫描中从未被直接观测到的区域会被周围纹理污染且未得到修正，这限制了网格保真度和新视角合成的上限。我们提出一种“先分解再重建”的方法：从每一帧中分割出各个实例，将剩余部分视为背景并进行修补（inpaint），使用网格溅射独立地重建每个实例和背景，最后将它们组合成单一场景。我们的方法显著提升了网格保真度（F分数提升超过5%）和新视角合成质量，同时支持对象级别的可修改性与交互性。代码将公开发布。
tldr: 提出“先分解再重建”的对象级网格溅射方法，通过实例分割、背景修补与独立重建再组合，显著提升3D场景重建的网格保真度（F分数提升超5%），并支持对象级编辑与交互。
en_tdlr: Proposes a decompose-before-reconstruct object-level mesh splatting approach that segments instances, inpaints the background, reconstructs each part independently, and composes them into a scene, significantly improving mesh fidelity (over 5% F-score gain) and enabling object-wise editing and interactivity.
